messages:
Zoe: opened PR to tidy up the hello-petal quickstart: fix auth var, add explicit docker port mapping, and a short migration note for SDK v8. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1412 — need quick review.
Ishan: taking a look. Node example uses REDWOOD_KEY in one place. we standardized to REDWOOD_API_KEY last quarter — pls update.
Marta: also the docker run example is missing -p mapping; CI preview couldn't reach the app. add EXPOSE in Dockerfile and `docker run -p 5000:5000`.
doc-bot: lint: flagged client.call usage and inconsistent code-fence languages. recommend client.generate and matching fence labels.
Zoe: good catches, pushed commit to switch env var and replace client.call -> client.generate. updated fences to javascript/typescript where appropriate.
Ishan: added a tiny migration blurb about SDK v8 default timeout changes and how to set timeouts in the client config. pushed to the branch.
preview-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-1412--docs.redwood-ai.com/quickstarts/hello-petal — smoke tests passed.
Marta: i verified the docker compose healthcheck and explicit port mapping. added a one-line note that sample outputs may vary (no seeded outputs in examples).
Zoe: plan to merge once CI stabilizes, then tag a docs patch and update changelog. ETA 15-25m.
Ishan: small follow-up — normalized all references to "API key (REDWOOD_API_KEY)" across the quickstart and migration guide to reduce support confusion.
Marta: :thumbsup: i'll run a final link sweep post-merge and file a redirect if we find any external anchors that still point to old headers.

---

Node snippet from PR:
```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'petal-mini', prompt: 'say hello in haiku' });
console.log(resp.text);
```

Python snippet from PR:
```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
out = client.generate(model='petal-mini', prompt='say hello in haiku')
print(out.text)
```

Action items: Zoe - merge & tag release; Ishan - follow up on migration guide wording; Marta - post-merge link sweep and redirect PR if needed.
